volume_compression.description: Contracts with norm_volume < 0.1 are compressed into the bottom 10% of the scale. 98.7% of the universe is below 0.1 norm_volume.

neutral_spread.observation: Contracts with neutral spread receive exactly 0.0750 spread contribution (= SPREAD_WEIGHT * 0.5 = 0.15 * 0.5). This is mid-range, so they are neither rewarded nor penalized relative to the median spread contract.
